transcript.content: Hi, I’m glad you came in. What brings you in today?

Um, well... I guess I'm just having trouble staying on track with things. Like, I'll be working on something for school, maybe trying to finish a project, and... I don't know, a message pops up, or I just think of something else I need to do, and I just lose focus on what I was actually supposed to be doing.
Did you have this same kind of trouble focusing when you were a child?

Yeah... I guess so. Um, my parents usually had to sit right next to me when I did homework back then. If they didn't, I would just kind of... wander off, or start doing something else before I finished. 

And... I guess my elementary school teachers used to write comments about it. Just stuff about me rushing through worksheets, or... losing track of the directions. I think they also said I talked over other kids a lot during group work. So... yeah.
Do these focus problems cause significant trouble for you in more than one part of your life, such as both school and home?

Yeah. Um... I guess it affects a few different things. Not just regular classes. 

Like... I've lost a couple of small freelance contracts recently. Just... people feeling like they couldn't rely on me to follow through cleanly, I guess. And I missed out on a portfolio competition because of it. 

Um... it kind of affects things with my friends, too.
